# optimizelycmp_label_group (Data Source)

Looks up one label group by name. It fails if there is no match or more than one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "optimizelycmp_label_group" "pillar" {
  name = "Content Pillar"
}

output "pillar_values" {
  value = data.optimizelycmp_label_group.pillar.value_names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Label group name (case-insensitive exact match).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the label group.
- `source_org_type` (String)
- `value_names` (List of String)
